name: nju-login-pro
description: Offline verification commands for the NJU Login Pro browser extension.

scripts.verify: npm run verify:repository && npm run verify:auth && npm run verify:popup && npm run verify:click-captcha
scripts.verify:auth: node scripts/verify-auth-login-fast-path.mjs && node scripts/verify-auth-slider-captcha.mjs && node scripts/verify-auth-session-prewarm.mjs
scripts.verify:click-captcha: node scripts/verify-captcha-test-context.mjs && node scripts/verify-click-captcha-sampler.mjs && node scripts/verify-click-captcha-solver.mjs
